newsitem.title: USA: IMF to lend Peru $223 mln for debt reduction plan.
newsitem.headline: IMF to lend Peru $223 mln for debt reduction plan.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund said on Thursday it approved the release of $223 million to Peru to back up the country's debt reduction operation.
"The operation is cost effective and is expected to provide the basis for a return to voluntary financing by foreign commercial creditors," the IMF said in a statement.
The money is being made available through the release of $151 million from Peru's existing Extended Fund Facility credit, coupled with the addition of $72 million to that credit, the IMF said.
